title: Firewall in a Rowhouse with Secondary Suites
summary: Lets a rowhouse whose houses have secondary suites leave out the firewall that Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) would otherwise need, if every fire-safety feature below is built: fire separations around exits and between suites, rated construction, egress, ducts, doors and penetrations.

source.title: City of Calgary, Variance SPV-006 Firewall in a Rowhouse with Secondary Suites (19 June 2025)

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: The building has more than two houses, and adjacent houses with a secondary suite would otherwise need a firewall between them under Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2).

source.label: Reason for Variance
source.quote: in a building which contains more than 2 houses, a party wall that separates any two adjacent houses with a secondary suite, shall be constructed as a firewall.

conditions.subject: project
conditions.plain: You follow the package exactly as published. Any change means either the Division B acceptable solution or a site-specific variance, and a site-specific variance to Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) needs a professional involved.

source.label: Note
source.quote: Standing Posted Variances (SPV) cannot be altered or deviated from.

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: The firewall is left out only if the design includes every fire-safety feature listed below (items 1 to 7).

source.label: Acceptable method of Variance
source.quote: Where a design incorporates the fire safety features as identified below, a firewall required by Division B 9.10.11.2.(2) need not be provided.

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: Any duct through a fire separation without a fire damper is noncombustible, with a melting point of at least 760 C (see also Clause 9.33.1.1.(3)).
conditions.when: Only where ducts pass through a fire separation without fire dampers.

source.label: 5. a)
source.quote: Ducts penetrating fire separations need not be equipped with fire dampers in conformance with Article 9.10.13.13. provided they are noncombustible having a melting point not below 760

conditions.subject: building

conditions.when: Only where ducts pass through a fire separation without fire dampers.

source.label: 5. a)
source.quote: with all openings in the duct system serving only one fire compartment.

conditions.subject: permit_documents
conditions.plain: Heating, ventilating and air-conditioning drawings go in with the permit application, showing the size and continuity of all pipes, ducts, shafts, flues and fire dampers.

source.label: 5. b)

source.label: 5. b)
source.quote: the location, size, capacity and type of all principal units of equipment, and the size and location of all combustion air and ventilation openings.

conditions.plain: Each door in a fire separation has a closure with at least a 20-minute fire-protection rating, or is a 45 mm solid-core wood door as in Article 9.10.13.2.

source.label: 6. a)

conditions.subject: building

source.label: 6. a)
source.quote: and shall be installed with a self-closing device.

conditions.subject: building

source.label: 6. b)

source_notes.plain: If you need to change anything, a site-specific variance to Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) needs a professional involved in the application.
source_notes.quote: If a site-specific variance is applied for to vary Division B, Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) professional involvement is required as part of the application.

source_notes.plain: Figure 2 on page 5 summarises the package in a drawing (45-minute separations when not sprinklered, penetrations to Division B 9.10.9., two means of egress when only shared egress is provided or the building is not sprinklered, no dampers for noncombustible ducts serving one compartment). The written items above are what the checklist follows; the figure's egress wording reads differently from item 4, so ask the City if they seem to disagree for your design.
If you rely on this package to get a permit, not meeting its requirements is an offence under the Safety Codes Act.
source_notes.quote: If this variance is relied upon to obtain a permit, non-compliance with the requirements of this variance are an offence under the Safety Codes Act.
